notes.title: Waiting for the Loop is released!
notes.notes:
Waiting for the Loop is a short form visual novel that was born out of a desire to tell a type of story in a game that isn't told very often. It is a game made by 3 people in the indie game development community in Portland, Oregon.
We hope that you enjoy Waiting for the Loop and are excited to work on new projects in the future that continue to push the boundaries of what a game story can be.

You can purchase Waiting for the Loop on the Steam store page, as well as the game's soundtrack and a remixed EP by the game's composer.
